project.name: qr-pipeline
project.title: DAV Pipeline
project.description: Content creation pipeline for social media creators. Extracts transcripts from YouTube/TikTok/Instagram videos, rewrites them into multilingual QR-format scripts (FR/EN/DE/ES), generates TTS audio in multiple languages, and provides a separate video downloader tab powered by yt-dlp and Cloudflare R2.

backend_nextjs.transcript: Supadata API (native captions + AI generation fallback)

pages.description: Main application page. Contains the tab switcher between Scripts and Download tabs. Scripts tab handles the full pipeline: URL input → transcript extraction → AI rewrite → multilingual script cards → TTS generation. Download tab renders the Flask /app iframe.

tabs.label: Scripts
tabs.description: Full content pipeline: paste a video URL, extract transcript via Supadata, rewrite with Claude into QR-format scripts in FR/EN/DE/ES with title+hashtag sections, generate TTS audio in up to 5 providers, adjust script duration, copy sections.

tabs.label: Download
tabs.description: DAV Downloader embedded as a full-height iframe pointing to the Flask /app route. Allows downloading any video (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, etc.) as MP4 or MP3. Shows real-time download progress via SSE, uploads to Cloudflare R2, and delivers a presigned download link.

pages.description: Self-contained single-page HTML/CSS/JS app served by Flask. Dark cyberpunk UI with DAV DOWNLOAD branding. Includes URL input, platform detection badge, format (MP4/MP3) selector, quality selector (best/1080/720/480/360), progress bar (real % from yt-dlp SSE), and download history.

nextjs_api_routes.description: Extracts transcript from a video URL. Detects platform (YouTube/TikTok/Instagram), calls Supadata API with native captions first (1 credit), falls back to AI generation (2 credits/min). Handles async jobs (HTTP 202) by polling. Returns transcript text, video title, platform, and detected language.

Rewrites a transcript into multilingual QR-format scripts using Claude Sonnet 4.6. Streams the response as plain text. The QR format contains sections: SCRIPT FR/EN/DE/ES, SEARCH KEYWORDS EN, TITRE ET HASHTAGS FR/EN/DE/ES. Supports optional target duration (10s to 2min at 130 wpm).
Rewrites a single script section to a target duration using Claude Sonnet 4.6. Preserves tone, style and narrative connectors. Streams response as plain text.

Submits TTS generation job via AI33Pro proxy for ai33-elevenlabs (ElevenLabs eleven_multilingual_v2) or ai33-minimax (Minimax speech-2.6-hd). Returns a taskId for async polling. Returns apiKey so the browser can poll AI33Pro directly to avoid Vercel timeouts.
Polls AI33Pro for TTS task completion. Routes to /v1m/ for Minimax or /v1/ for ElevenLabs. Normalises the response to always return { status, audio_url }.
Direct ElevenLabs TTS using the official SDK. Uses voice aTTiK3YzK3dXETpuDE2h with model eleven_multilingual_v2, output mp3_44100_128. Returns audio/mpeg stream directly (no async job).
Google Cloud Text-to-Speech via REST API. Supports Neural2 voices, adjustable speaking rate (0.25–4.0). Returns decoded MP3 buffer.
Microsoft Edge TTS via edge-tts-universal package. Free, no API key required. Supports rate (e.g. +30%), volume, pitch. Returns MP3 audio buffer.
Keep-alive endpoint pinged by GitHub Actions every 14 minutes to prevent Render free-tier sleep.

flask_routes.description: Health check. Returns server status, R2 connectivity, ffmpeg binary path, and /tmp download folder path.
Synchronous yt-dlp download to /tmp. Blocks until complete. Kept for compatibility; the SSE route is preferred.

Main download endpoint. Streams SSE events: progress (0–100%), uploading, done. yt-dlp saves to /tmp, ffmpeg merges (imageio-ffmpeg binary), file is uploaded to Cloudflare R2, /tmp file is deleted, a same-origin redirect token is generated and returned.

Same-origin redirect gateway. Looks up a short-lived token (1h TTL) in server memory and returns HTTP 302 to the R2 presigned URL. Solves the iframe cross-origin download restriction: the browser navigates same-origin first, then follows the redirect to R2 where Content-Disposition: attachment triggers the save dialog.
Fallback direct-stream route. Runs yt-dlp with -o - (stdout) and pipes bytes directly to the browser without saving to disk. No R2, no merging for video. Used as a fallback when R2 is not configured.
flask_routes.response: video/mp4 or audio/mpeg binary stream with Content-Disposition: attachment

flask_routes.description: Returns in-memory download history for the current server session (last 20 entries).
Diagnostic endpoint. Uploads a 4-byte test file to R2, generates a presigned URL, then deletes it. Returns full boto3 error on failure.
Serves the self-contained DAV Downloader HTML/CSS/JS single-page app. Embedded as an iframe in the Next.js Download tab.

nextjs_proxy_rewrites.description: next.config.ts rewrites that proxy Flask routes through the single Next.js port (3000 locally, shared on Render). Flask runs on localhost:5757.

components.name: Header
components.description: Sticky top navigation bar. Contains: DAV PIPELINE logo + version badge, hidden CTA toggle dot (discreet, invisible to casual visitors) with position popover (sentence 2/3/4), command palette trigger (⌘K), history panel (dropdown, up to 50 entries with restore/delete), reset button.

components.name: UrlInput
components.description: Video URL input field with submit button. Shows error state. Triggers transcript extraction on Enter or button click.

components.name: GenerationPanel
components.description: TTS control panel shown after script generation. Contains: TTS provider selector (AI33/Direct/Free groups), duration selector (10s–2min or original), per-language generation rows (LanguageRow), generate-all button, copy-all-QR button.

components.name: ScriptCard
components.description: Card for a single language script section (FR/EN/DE/ES). Shows content, word/time stats, duration adjustment buttons (10s–2min), copy button, audio playback and download when TTS is ready, restore-original button when overridden.

components.name: LanguageRow
components.description: Single row in GenerationPanel for one language. Shows voice selector and speed control (persisted to localStorage per provider+lang), generate button, audio player/download when ready. Voice list differs per provider.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.description: ⌘K command palette (cmdk). Actions: paste URL, generate FR/EN/DE/ES audio, generate all, copy all QR, reset. Keyboard-driven, accessible via ⌘K or header button.

components.name: FloatingActions
components.description: Floating action button visible on mobile when scripts are ready. Provides quick access to copy-all-QR.

components.name: CTAToggle
components.description: Standalone CTA toggle component (also integrated in Header). Controls CTA injection on/off and sentence position.

lib_files.description: Utility functions: sanitizes video titles for filenames, computes word count and estimated speaking duration, formats ISO dates for display.
Tailwind class merging helper using clsx + tailwind-merge.
Curated list of Microsoft Edge TTS neural voices per language (FR/EN/DE/ES) with display names.
Curated list of Google Cloud Neural2 TTS voices per language with langCode mappings.

features.name: Health Score System (v2.8+)
features.description: After each rewrite, Claude Haiku scores all 4 scripts on 6 criteria (hook opening, sentence count, no dashes, connector preservation, independence, no banned words) for a 0-100 score per language. Score bar shown in each ScriptCard: green ≥80, amber ≥60, red <80.

features.name: Auto-Correction on Low Score (v2.9)
features.description: Scripts scoring < 80 are automatically sent to /api/correct-script for targeted correction using Claude Sonnet 4.6. Up to 2 retry attempts per language. Shows 'Correction…' indicator on the card while in progress. Health score updates after each attempt.

features.name: Remove Silence (fixed v2.9)
features.description: Removes silence from TTS audio using the NeuralFalcon HuggingFace Space. Client fetches audio blob, converts to base64, sends JSON {audioBase64, mimeType}. Server pings HF Space to wake it up, uploads, polls SSE, returns {processedUrl}.

features.name: Copy URL Button (v2.8+)
features.description: Small 🔗 button next to the video title that copies the source URL to clipboard. Shows 'Copié !' for 1 second.

features.name: Custom Duration Per Script (v2.9)
features.description: Each ScriptCard has a custom 'sec' input field after the preset duration buttons. Enter any number of seconds and press Enter or blur to trigger adjustment via /api/adjust with customSeconds parameter.

features.name: Dynamic Health Score Updates (v2.9)
features.description: Health score refreshes after each manual script adjustment (handleAdjust), and after auto-correction completes. Only the adjusted language's score is updated.

features.name: Keywords Client-Side Filter (v2.9)
features.description: Keywords from the SEARCH KEYWORDS EN section are filtered client-side: any line with more than 4 words is truncated to 4 words before display.

features.name: Transcript Extraction
features.description: Paste a YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram URL. Fetches transcript via Supadata API — tries native captions first (cheaper), falls back to AI generation. Handles async jobs. Auto-fetches video title via YouTube oEmbed.

features.name: QR Script Generation
features.description: Rewrites transcript into the Quad Remix (QR) format using Claude Sonnet 4.6: 4 script languages (FR/EN/DE/ES), English search keywords, and title+hashtag sets for all 4 languages. Streamed in real-time with skeleton cards during generation.

features.name: Duration Adjustment
features.description: Per-script-section duration adjust: re-rewrites a single language to 10s/15s/30s/45s/1min/1min30/2min at 130 wpm target. Streamed. Preserves original alongside override with restore button.

features.name: CTA Injection System
features.description: Hidden CTA (Call-To-Action) toggle accessible via a discreet dot in the header. When enabled, inserts a multilingual CTA sentence (Cristiano smiles when you tap the plus button) into each script at sentence position 2, 3, or 4. CTA is baked into audio generation and copy output. Persisted to localStorage.

features.name: Multi-Provider TTS
features.description: 5 TTS providers: AI33Pro-ElevenLabs (async polling), AI33Pro-Minimax (async polling), ElevenLabs Direct (streaming), Edge TTS (free, Microsoft neural voices, no API key), Google Cloud TTS (Neural2). Voice and speed saved per provider+language in localStorage. Generate all 4 languages in parallel.

features.name: Command Palette
features.description: ⌘K palette for keyboard-first workflow: quick URL paste, generate per language, generate all, copy all QR, reset.

features.name: History
features.description: Stores last 50 generated scripts in localStorage. Restore any past entry (title, URL, scripts, provider) with one click. Delete individual entries or clear all.

features.name: DAV Downloader (Download Tab)
features.description: Video downloader embedded as iframe. Supports YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, Snapchat, Dailymotion, Facebook, Vimeo. Downloads via yt-dlp with ffmpeg merge (imageio-ffmpeg). Real-time SSE progress bar. Uploads to Cloudflare R2, returns presigned URL via same-origin redirect token to bypass iframe cross-origin restrictions.

features.name: Cloudflare R2 Storage
features.description: Downloaded files are uploaded to R2 bucket dav-downloads (EU jurisdiction). Files are stored with UUID-prefixed keys. Presigned URLs valid for 1 hour. Background thread deletes expired R2 objects and redirect tokens every 10 minutes.

features.name: Keep-Alive (GitHub Actions)
features.description: GitHub Actions workflow pings /api/ping every 14 minutes to prevent Render free-tier instance sleep.

qr_format.description: QR (Quad Remix) is the proprietary script format used by this pipeline. Each output contains 9 sections.

deployment.service_type: Web Service — single process running both Next.js and Flask
deployment.architecture: Next.js proxies Flask routes via next.config.ts rewrites. Flask runs on internal port 5757, Next.js on the public port. Both share the same Render instance.
deployment.keep_alive: GitHub Actions workflow pings /api/ping every 14 minutes

r2_storage.cleanup: Background daemon thread, runs every 10 minutes

notes: Flask must be running for the Download tab to work
R2 credentials in .env.render are loaded automatically by dav_downloader.py via load_dotenv()
imageio-ffmpeg provides a bundled ffmpeg binary — no system ffmpeg install needed
yt-dlp downloads to /tmp/downloads before R2 upload
